card.name: Start of drug interaction statements
card.fires_on: Words that begin the effect statement right after an interacting drug or class is named in a drug interaction section, such as 'increase', 'Increases', 'there' or 'ants' in CNS Depressants.

modes.description: The verb 'increase' or 'Increases' opens a statement about raised levels of the named drug.
